description_en: Updates the information of a specified Skill
description_zh: 更新指定 Skill 的信息
name: UpdateSkill

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the Skill
parameters.name: skill_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the Skill. The name can contain only lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens
parameters.help_zh: Skill 名称，只能包含小写字母、数字和连字符
parameters.name: name

parameters.example: SQL审查专家：全面审核SQL的安全性、性能与规范性，识别风险并提供优化建议。用户提交SQL或询问“SQL审核”“SQL Review”“有风险吗”“如何优化”时，立即启用。
parameters.help_en: The description of the Skill. The description can be up to 1000 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: Skill 描述，最多 1000 个字符
parameters.name: description

parameters.example: {"MySQL": "MySQL 优化指南...","PostgreSQL": "PostgreSQL 优化指南..."}
parameters.name: content

parameters.help_en: The ContextDB workspace ID. Do not specify this parameter for regular Skill calls
parameters.help_zh: ContextDB 工作空间 ID；普通Skill调用不传
parameters.name: workspace_id

parameters.help_en: The upload session ID returned by GetUploadPolicy for ContextDB full package updates. Do not specify this parameter for original RDS field updates
parameters.help_zh: ContextDB 完整包更新使用 GetUploadPolicy 返回的上传会话 ID；原 RDS 字段更新不传
parameters.name: upload_id

parameters.help_en: The upload session token paired with UploadId, used to verify ownership. Do not specify this parameter for original RDS field updates
parameters.help_zh: 与 UploadId 配套的上传会话凭证，用于校验归属；原 RDS 字段更新不传
parameters.name: upload_token

parameters.help_en: The version update note for the ContextDB Skill. Specify this parameter when confirming storage after the check passes. The note can be up to 1000 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: ContextDB Skill 版本更新说明；校验通过后在确认入库时填写，最长 1000 字符
parameters.name: update_note
